i.norm: Verifies that a string beginning with the default escape/prefix character '$' but containing no valid variable syntax (i.e. no '${...}' pattern) is returned verbatim by replace(CharSequence), and that the default escape character is '$'.
A plain string that starts with '$' but is NOT a variable reference (missing the '{...}' brackets), so nothing should be substituted.
The default escape character for StrSubstitutor is '$'.
Because the input contains no recognised variable pattern, the result must be non-null and identical to the original input.
